FAST mixing the envelope by the given df and phase.
dynamical=True means phase keeps 0 at t=0 (i.e. env * exp(i * (-2* pi * df * t + phase)).
dynamical=False means phase keeps 0 at t=dt(env>>dt) (i.e. env * exp(i * (-2* pi * df * (t - dt) + phase)).
